ai.title: Add custom stream parser to suppress file content emission
ai.summary: Implemented `processStreamWithFiles` in `backend/src/process-stream.ts` to intercept and buffer file blocks during streaming, preventing raw file contents from being emitted to the client. Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to use this new generator, replacing the previous logic that accumulated and parsed file blocks manually. The parser yields only the opening/closing tags and non-file text, calling `onFileStart` and `onFile` callbacks to handle file processing internally.

eli5.text: When the assistant works on files behind the scenes, it now holds back the actual file contents so they no longer get streamed out to whoever is watching. Instead of sending the raw text of each file as it works, the assistant only shares the surrounding explanation and uses internal callbacks to handle files separately. If you were observing a live session, you'd see the assistant's commentary continue without the file contents being dumped in the middle of the stream. This behavior is live as of 2024-08-22.
